name: ugt-devops-mcp
description: Read-only MCP servers for the org Jenkins and SonarQube: list jobs, build status with pipeline stages, console log tail, open issues and Quality Gate status. Asks for the server URLs and personal API tokens when the plugin is enabled; tokens go to the OS credential store, not env vars. Optional — install only if you want Claude to read Jenkins/SonarQube directly.

jenkins_user.title: Jenkins username
jenkins_user.description: The Jenkins user that owns the API token below

jenkins_token.title: Jenkins API token
jenkins_token.description: Jenkins → your user → Configure → API Token (not your password)

sonarqube_token.title: SonarQube user token
sonarqube_token.description: SonarQube → My Account → Security → Generate token (type: User)
